objective: Correct Matthew Henry commentary source coverage in My Bible verse navigation and add truthful language-sensitive, on-device optional translation without changing scripture, native binaries, daily plan or production.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main commit 69ff92b22b13e26490a93f685ebc89d28e3d6cbf confirmed before editing. Existing library uses helloao English commentary with 4124 commentary entries over 1167 chapters; production content cannot be assumed per-verse. Existing optional BuklodMlKitTranslation Android module is present in source but installed APK compatibility not yet evidenced.
chosenApproach: Preserve exact verse records; only expand source-explicit passage ranges, label unsourced gaps contextual instead of falsely assigning Henry's words. Follow the Bible translation's language code; translate with existing optional Google ML Kit on-device module and account-scoped cache, with Wi-Fi-only initial model download, readable English fallback and original-English toggle. No remote translation service. New cache version isolates prior shape.
selectionRationale: Use existing source and optional module without extra cost, permissions, backend or native code changes. Safeguard theology accuracy and slow-network reading; do not falsely claim a uniquely authored commentary for every verse.
alternativeApproaches: Fabricate verse-by-verse text for empty entries: rejected because misleading
Download whole copyright-mixed Bible datasets: rejected for cost and licensing risk
Call paid cloud translation APIs: rejected since native optional translation already exists
Release unverified Android OTA: rejected pending exact RC, native compatibility and attribution gates
preserveBehaviors: My Bible verse text, chapter selection and original English Henry remain accurate
Strong's source-matched KJV word links unaffected
Daily plan completion, progress, bookmarks and annotations unchanged
No extra database queries or new network dependency for reading
No staging or production release without exact runtime and manifest checks
